title: Grateful Dead Live at The Mosque on 1977-05-25
lineage: 3rd generation reel played back on Otari MX-5050BII> Korg MR-1000 (DSF [1-bit 5.6448 MHz Stereo]) Korg AudioGate > WAV [24/96] > Adobe Audition 3.0> Ozone 4.0> FLAC encoding Speed/Pitch Correction by Joe B. Jones. Patching using source SHNID 87591.
taper: Justin Lee. Thanks to Pat Lee for providing the reel.
source: Recorded with Nakamichi CM-300s> Nakamichi 550 (except for Cassidy through Promised Land; recorded with Sony ECM-99> Sony 158)

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience tape with crisp taper work, highlighted by a gorgeous Scarlet Begonias → Fire on the Mountain sequence.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about this 1977 recording, praising the pure, unadulterated taping and the beautiful Scarlet Begonias into Fire on the Mountain pairing. The tape has been carefully cross‑faded for continuity, resulting in good‑to‑excellent sound quality despite its unknown exact source. Overall enthusiasm suggests a top‑tier show and a highly listenable archive release.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers gave 4–5 stars, praised the taper work and highlighted standout songs; only one neutral/negative comment with no substantive criticism.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Tape compiled from SHNID source with cross‑fades for continuity; praised by tapers for being pure and unadulterated, indicating solid clarity despite being an audience recording.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Specific set‑list details not mentioned; reviewers expressed overall enthusiasm for the performance.
